According to the Collective Agreement, monetary compensation is paid no earlier than after the actual use of 28 calendar days of annual paid leave, except for additional annual paid leave for work in harmful and/or hazardous conditions, for the corresponding work year. The number of available days is calculated taking this requirement into account.
